notes.title: Beach Island Deluxe - Version 2.1.0
notes.content:
[b][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*]Sprint Island checkpoint now has fans on the other side.
[*]Volume of footsteps lowered
[*]Power Windy Peak's fan blades are slightly reduced (unnecessarily difficult)
[*]There is now a platform under 'Climb the Metal Wall' (unnecessarily difficult)
[*]Plugged up a hole in the wall players could get stuck in
[*]Added an FPS cap option, should help stabilize framerates
[*]The version number is now visible on screen when speed running
[*]There is now an achievement tracker visible on the main menu (the 5 stars at the bottom of the screen)
[*]You can now turn off the notification of controller changing
[*]There is now an autosave feature. The game will autosave every time you get a star or shortcut
[*]Your progress is shown on the main menu
[*]Your fastest speedrun records are now shown on the main menu
[*]There is now a shortcut added to the Waterfall Ruins for when you return
[/list]

[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed camera issues with fans in Windy Peak
[*]There is now a proper loading screen, any bugs with the game crashing trying to load should be fixed
[*]Fixed bugs with the HUD/UI not working properly at different aspect ratios
[*]Fixed a bug with the starlist and control panel, they now stay up until the button is pressed again
[*]Fixed a glitch with music volume not changing at the right times
[/list]

notes.title: Beach Island Deluxe Version 2.1 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Coming soon the last and final update, v2.1 will be live! There are some big major new features coming to Beach Island Deluxe! 

[list]
[*]The HUD and UI should scale correctly at ALL resolutions!
[*]There is an auto-save feature! You can now leave and come back at your pleasure!
[*]There is an achievement tracker on the main menu that tracks your achievement progress and speedrun records!
[*]Along with a bunch of minor tweaks and bug fixes!
[/list]

This is the best possible version of Beach Island Deluxe that the developer is able to give you and it’s arriving on all available platforms to play Beach Island Deluxe on! On the same day of the update, the soundtrack, Rhythm and Beach, will also be available to download for FREE! The soundtrack includes all of the music from the game, along with developer commentary and beta tracks!

Although this is the last update for Beach Island Deluxe, it doesn’t have to be the end of it’s story. Please continue sharing the game with those you think will enjoy it. We hope you'll enjoy the upcoming update, and thank you for playing!
